    Finiteness of the detector index in finite representation type #

    The literal string module attached to a detector index is indecomposable. A finite complete indecomposable skeleton therefore assigns it a skeleton label. The diagonal/off-diagonal detector calculation shows that two indices with the same label must coincide. Thus the full family of finite-string detectors is finite in the representation-finite setting.
